title: 事象の地平線に眠る数式
author: 七海 シグマ

en.title: The Equation Sleeping on the Event Horizon
en.premise: At an observation base near a black hole where a gravity anomaly has slowed time to a crawl, physicist Rei discovers his predecessor's will and a hidden underground library. Inside lies forbidden physics calculation data that could prevent the universe's collapse. In this extreme environment, he confronts the brutal cosmic truth revealed by the equations.

zh.title: 事象的地平线中沉睡的方程式
zh.premise: 在因重力异常导致时间几乎停滞的黑洞近旁观测基地，物理学家レイ发现了前任留下的遗嘱以及隐藏的地下图书馆。那里藏有能够阻止宇宙崩溃的禁忌物理运算数据。在极端环境下，他面对由方程式揭示的残酷宇宙真相。
